series.name: Official overall disaster-risk index (IRBI)
series.directionExplanation: Higher official index indicates greater modeled disaster risk, not weaker capacity alone or more realized2023 disasters.
series.reportingBias: Not primarily annual event-report count; depends on older model inputs, risk modelling, capacity assessment and annual assessment/revision coverage.
series.comparability: One official table, same2023 index vintage and administrative27 kabupaten/kota; names map uniquely to distinct canonical BPS codes. Not a claim of certified2023 spatial inputs.
series.redundancy: Contains H/V/C; exposure enters vulnerability. Do not add its hazard-specific risk scores, IKD or vulnerability/exposure components as extra independent CORE. Socioeconomic/service conceptual links remain implicit and must be disclosed, not duplicated with extra resilience proxies.

source.title: Indeks Risiko Bencana Indonesia Tahun 2023 (IRBI), Volume 02 Nomor 02, Januari 2024
source.table: Tabel nilai indeks risiko Provinsi Jawa Barat dari Tahun 2015 sampai dengan Tahun 2023; printed/PDF 101
source.referencePeriod: Official 2023 index vintage; hazard/vulnerability baseline IRBI 2013 from KRB 2011; capacity assessed through IKD 71 indicators. Annual assessment freshness must be checked separately.

recommendation.reason: KEEP, narrowly labelled modeled Disaster Pressure; complete official2023 residual-risk composite, no extra nested components. Older baselines and assessment freshness constrain interpretation, not hidden new2023 hazards.

caveats: Not comprehensive resilience capacity or observed losses.
Hazard/vulnerability are older fixed baselines, not a fresh2023 exposure census.
National419/514 IKD assessments do not prove27/27 current assessment; annual index publication differs from annual remeasurement.
Official component weights H40/V30/C30 describe BNPB methodology; not CIVX weights.
No population denominator; dividing composite by residents is invalid.
Rights, independent method review and certified effective spatial compatibility remain separate future-release governance gates.

series.name: Indeks risiko bencana Banjir 2023
series.formula: Published BNPB hazard-specific risk score combining classified hazard, vulnerability/exposure/loss components, and government capacity. H/V baseline IRBI2013 (KRB2011); capacity updated via IKD. Do not equate to overall IRBI or physical hazard intensity.
series.directionExplanation: Higher published score means higher modeled residual risk for this hazard. Natural direction retained.
series.reportingBias: Model/baseline and district capacity-assessment coverage; not event-reporting frequency. District-specific fresh 2023 IKD assessment not established.
series.comparability: Same 2023 publication and hazard construction across named districts, but H/V are historical structural baselines. Different hazards have different score ranges and applicability.
series.redundancy: Hazard-specific component/alternative to overall IRBI, with repeated H/V/capacity structure; additive use beside overall IRBI double counts unless nonredundancy proven.
